text.description_html:
RK International CK-321, Retro White Porcelain Flower Cabinet Knob

A sweet addition to any space, the White Porcelain Flower Cabinet Knob has a retro feel. It is made from white porcelain with a brass center and rose. The White Flower Porcelain Cabinet Knob with Polished Brass comes packaged with all the necessary installation hardware.

Also Available Matching CP-353 White Porcelain Flower Cabinet Pull

Specifications and Features of the RK International CK-321 Porcelain Floral Cabinet Hardware:

  • Material: porcelain with some brass
  • Finish: Polished Brass
  • Diameter: 1-1/4"
  • Projection: 1-3/8"
  • Screw: 1" long #8 - 32 machine screw.
  • Packaged with all necessary installation hardware.

Sold Individually
